name: PlenOctree Fusion
definition: A coarse-to-fine strategy to obtain a completed PlenOctree by fusing local PlenOctrees from multiple target views, filtering redundant leaves, and refining leaf values using transmittance-based weighting instead of gradient descent.
summary: PlenOctree Fusion constructs high-quality sparse octrees for real-time rendering by fusing local trees and refining values via transmittance-based weighting, avoiding slow gradient descent.
